'''2006 World Championship 6 V-Card Tournament Garrett Larson DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Garrett Larson]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (6 V-Card Tournament); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Michael "mc9457" Carr (2006-11-07).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35790 Garret Larson's 6 V-Card Deck - Hunt Down]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071213225958/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35790 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Garret Larson's 6 V-Card Deck - Hunt Down'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "mc9457" Carr
* '''Published:''' November 7, 2006
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' Garret Larson's Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi Deck that he used for the 6 V-Card Tournament

=== Strategy ===

This deck went 3-0, with full wins against Michael Rebman, Jim Beyer and Brain Fred.
